description: This file contains pattern definitions and utility functions for classifying source files based on their filenames and paths, primarily aimed at distinguishing code, test, API, and infrastructure artifacts within a codebase.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a file path to normalize path formats.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a given file path into categories such as code file, test file, API barrel, runtime API barrel, infrastructure artifact, or production source based on regex pattern matching.
